style.styleTitle: Personalised Highland Cow Christmas Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Bring a cosy touch of rustic charm to your festive decor with this delightful Personalised Highland Cow Christmas Bauble. Featuring a charming Highland cow design, this ornament is full of warmth and character, making it a lovely addition to any Christmas tree. The bauble can be personalised with 2 lines of text on the front, each up to 15 characters, and an additional 4 lines of text on the reverse, each up to 20 characters. Please note, the text on line 1 (front) and lines 1 and 3 on the reverse is case sensitive and will appear exactly as entered, while all other personalisation will appear in fixed UPPERCASE. Complete with a ribbon, this unique bauble is ready to hang straight onto the tree, making it a perfect festive keepsake or thoughtful gift.
